title: Goodnight, Ding and Dang 🎶 #shorts #nurseryrhymes
description:
Sing along with us! 🎶

Lyrics :
Goodnight, the moon is shining,
Ding and Dang now close their eyes,
goodnight to all the birdies,
in their cozy little beds.

Goodnight, the moon is shining,
one small kiss upon your nose,
goodnight to all the birdies,
one big hug and off to sleep.

Original song by Ding Dang Nursery Rhymes: original lyrics, music and animation. Synthetic voice: Piper ("lessac" voice).

#nurseryrhymes #kidssongs #singalong
